title: Caught by a human
headSub: Most of the nine root-cause writeups began the same way: I was using the app, something looked wrong, and I went digging. The AI did not catch them. The loop a human runs around it did.

nodes.title: Found in real use
nodes.sub: not by a test - by me, using it

nodes.title: BUG-008 = BUG-006 again

takeaway.text: The model writes confident, plausible code. The only thing between plausible and correct was a human reading it and a test the human commissioned. {{green:Review did not get automated away. It got more important.}}
